gaps.lead: 'Did you send the invoice?' the manager asked her.
gaps.explanation: if/whether + subject + backshifted verb: whether she had sent.

gaps.lead: Although he is remarkably rich, he lives very simply.
gaps.explanation: Although he may be rich → Rich as (he) may be — fronted adjective + as + may.

gaps.lead: Nobody else in the team runs as fast as Maya.
gaps.explanation: nobody runs faster = she is the fastest runner.

gaps.lead: She'll be on a flight, so she can't join the call.
gaps.sentence: She'll be on a flight, so ___ join the call.
gaps.explanation: won't be able to = future inability.

gaps.lead: He began playing chess at the age of six.
gaps.sentence: He ___ at the age of six.
gaps.explanation: take up = start (a hobby or sport): took up chess.

gaps.lead: The bad weather meant we couldn't leave the house.
